notes: California 1400, Audace, Eldorado, MGX-21 and early V85 TT applications. A published diagnostic session log establishes K-Line initialization/session behaviour, the 1A 80 identification block (Drawing / Hardware / Software / Omologation / Serial / Tester), and a baud switch. GuzziDiag/IAWDiag changelogs establish that separate handle/throttle learning and other service functions exist, but do not disclose complete payloads, timing, security, or preconditions; all inferred routine, DTC, live-data, discovery, and memory definitions have been removed.
